utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what do you need fixed first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The front steps are the biggest worry right now. If someone could help with those first, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the front steps first. Want me to bring tools, or do you already have what we need?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but we should keep the repair drive simple and well-organized. What supplies do we already have, and what still needs to be picked up?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sounds right—can you confirm what’s already here, and what still needs to be bought?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I don’t have the inventory yet—let’s make a quick list of what’s on hand first, then we’ll see what still needs to be bought.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details; what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Just bring whatever you’ve got lying around that might still be useful—old tools, spare parts, screws, that sort of thing. If it’s in the garage, it’s probably worth a look!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—I’ll check the garage and dig up whatever I can find. If I uncover anything useful, I’ll bring it over.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for the repair drive, and I’ll tell the others too. Let’s keep it simple and get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I’ll spread the word while I’m out running errands too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep telling people as I see them. Let’s make sure everyone hears about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what do you need help with on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — I could use a drill and a few screwdrivers if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I’ve got those — I’ll grab them and head over.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—let’s keep it simple and set a clear time for the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Just bring a drill if you’ve got one, and maybe some spare screws. Let’s meet at 10 on Saturday and we’ll get it done fast.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can bring the drill and some spare screws. Saturday at 10 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Sam — are we still on for the repair drive, and what time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Mina — yes, we’re still on. Come by at 10:00 and we’ll get started together.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll be there at 10:00. Anything I should bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive — it’s a great way to help folks out and bring people together. If you want, I can help spread the word or coordinate a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be great, Jules. I can keep track of who’s interested and where we still need help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll start reaching out and let people know where help is needed. Just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m in for the repair drive—what do you need help with first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — first I need help making the sign-up list and calling a few neighbors who might need repairs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can handle the sign-up list and start calling neighbors. Who should I reach out to first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a note on the supplies, Bo—what do we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: We still need the basics—tools, tape, and a few extra hands if you can swing it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — I’ll check the tools and tape, and I’ll ask around for a few extra hands too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a good turnout already — folks are dropping off tools and supplies pretty steadily. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s good to hear. Let me know if they end up needing anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — if I hear they need anything specific, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I say more.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — it’s the repair drive at the school on Saturday morning, and we’re collecting small appliances, bikes, and linens. I can send the full list and drop-off time if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please send the full list and the drop-off time—I want to make sure I have the details right before I mention it to anyone.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I can help, just give me the quick version of the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s a neighborhood repair drive to collect tools, parts, and donations for the folks who need a hand. I can give you the details and where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, just the quick version is fine — what should I bring and where do I drop it off?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll tell the others about the repair drive and repeat the plan so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. I’ll make sure the repair drive details stay clear for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan to the neighbors so nobody misses the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details; what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Could you help collect a few tools and drop them off by the community shed? I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can do that. I’ll gather a few tools and drop them by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon. If you need a hand, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey — I might take you up on that. I’ve got a few tools I can bring by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, Gus. Just let me know what you’re bringing, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m putting the repair drive details in order now, and I’ll make sure Opal has everything she needs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — please send me the location details when you have them, and I’ll keep track of everything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’ll send over the location details as soon as I have them, and I’ll keep the rest of the list tidy for you too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the schedule and where everything needs to go first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the schedule and drop-off spots right away. We’re aiming to start Saturday morning by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thank you — please send the exact time and any parking details too, so I can plan my route.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still happening, right? I just want to make sure I’ve got that straight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, that’s still the plan — I just want to confirm the details before we do anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, thanks — I just wanted to confirm it’s still on.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I like that—let’s keep it simple and set a clear plan for the repair drive. Tell me the time and what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—I’ll swing by a little late, around 6:30. If you can bring a drill and a few extra screws, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 6:30 works for me. I’ll have the drill and extra screws ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s getting started soon—do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m pretty sure they still need tape, batteries, and a few basic tools. I’ll check what I’ve got on hand and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be helpful—I can ask around too if anything else is missing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, I just need a little reminder of what you wanted me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you bring a hammer, some screwdrivers, and any spare screws you’ve got? That’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll bring a hammer, some screwdrivers, and whatever spare screws I can find. If I forget anything, just give me a nudge.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup, but I’ll need to know when the repair drive is happening. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m thinking Saturday morning, around 9.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 9 works for me, and I can plan around school pickup if needed. Just let me know the exact spot.
